name: Descended autoresearch clarification → durable run result
description: Successful terminal needs_clarification from a run-triggered role is recorded on the run. Only an executing run forwards it to its canonical origin. The origin coordinator publishes a native routed clarification coordinator; baseline clarification remains on its existing native parent path.

metadata.includes_execute: Voluntary needs_clarification escalates; budgeted execute failure is not this path.
metadata.anchor_fence: Exactly one source run anchor is required; ambiguous multi-run values never use first-value selection for reply handoff.
